cites.stt: Has the Python GIL Been Slain? Subinterpreters in Python 3.8
cites.x: It is because only one thread at a time holds the lock in order to avoid race conditions. The keynote[1] by Raymond Hettinger from PyBay '17 will be a great place to start if you are new to this.
In any case, do you get to FORTRAN or C speeds? Probably not, but close enough, and with the benefits (and costs) of using Python code.
